title: Easy Thanksgiving Recipes
excerpt: Find easy Thanksgiving recipes for turkey, mashed potatoes, stuffing, green beans, gravy, and pumpkin pie, all gathered in one Grandma Recipe guide.

contentHtml:
Thanksgiving cooking feels best when the table is planned, not scrambled. This guide gathers Grandma Recipe’s best thanksgiving recipes, from juicy turkey and creamy sides to pumpkin desserts and make-ahead gravy, so you can build a menu without hunting through every category.

Use this page as your starting point. Each section links to kitchen-tested recipes with clear steps, familiar pantry ingredients, and family-friendly flavors for the big dinner, a smaller table for two, and cozy leftovers the next day.

How to Use This Thanksgiving Recipes Guide

Start with the kind of Thanksgiving recipe you need:

  • Need the main bird? Open oven-roasted turkey breast, Butterball turkey breast, or a frozen whole turkey plan.
  • Building the sideboard? Reach for mashed potatoes, rice stuffing, green beans, and gravy.
  • Want a dessert centerpiece? Classic pumpkin pie leads, with rolls, breads, and dump cake as backups.
  • Cooking for a smaller table? Turkey breast plus two sides and one dessert keeps the day calm.

If you want one first win with big impact, start with Oven-Roasted Bone Turkey Breast or Creamy Mashed Potatoes. For dessert, Classic Homemade Pumpkin Pie is the classic finish. For focused lists, open Thanksgiving Side Dishes, Thanksgiving Desserts, Thanksgiving Appetizers, or Thanksgiving Dinner Ideas.

The sections below give you room to browse at a calm pace, turkey first, then sides and desserts, with make-ahead tips and FAQs at the end.

Thanksgiving Turkey and Mains

Golden skin, juicy slices, and a main dish that anchors the whole menu.

  • How to Cook a Turkey, a full oven roast turkey guide with timing, seasoning, and resting tips.
  • Oven-Roasted Bone Turkey Breast, herb-kissed bone-in turkey breast with lemon and garlic.
  • Oven-Roasted Butterball Turkey Breast, Butterball turkey breast with citrus, rosemary, and a honey mustard glaze.
  • Frozen Whole Turkey, a clear plan for thawing and roasting a frozen whole turkey.

Thanksgiving Side Dishes

Creamy mash, savory stuffing, casseroles, cranberry sauce, and gravy that ties the plate together.

  • Creamy Mashed Potatoes, fluffy Yukon Gold mashed potatoes with garlic and chives.
  • Ultimate Loaded Mashed Potatoes, loaded mashed potatoes with cheddar, turkey bacon bits, and chives.
  • Mashed Potato Casserole, baked mashed potato casserole with a golden topping.
  • Classic Bread Stuffing, classic bread stuffing with onion, celery, and herbs.
  • Rice Stuffing, rice stuffing with onions, celery, cranberries, and herbs.
  • Homestyle Green Bean Casserole, green bean casserole with creamy sauce and crispy onions.
  • Classic Sweet Potato Casserole, sweet potato casserole with pecan streusel.
  • Homemade Cranberry Sauce, homemade cranberry sauce simmered until glossy.
  • Green Beans with Garlic and Almonds, green beans with garlic and toasted almonds.
  • Silky Homemade Turkey Gravy, turkey gravy from drippings or broth, no wine.
  • Homemade Gravy, homemade gravy for potatoes, stuffing, and turkey.
  • Vegan Gravy, dairy-free gravy with deep savory flavor.
  • Vegan Mashed Potatoes, creamy vegan mashed potatoes for plant-based plates.

Thanksgiving Desserts

Pumpkin spice, flaky crusts, and soft bakes for the dessert table.

  • Classic Homemade Pumpkin Pie, classic homemade pumpkin pie with a creamy spiced filling.
  • Classic Pumpkin Roll, pumpkin roll with cream cheese filling.
  • Grandma's Moist Pumpkin Bread, moist pumpkin bread for breakfast or a sweet side.
  • Soft Bakery-Style Pumpkin Muffins, bakery-style pumpkin muffins with a cinnamon sparkle.
  • Pumpkin Dump Cake, easy pumpkin dump cake when you want dessert without fuss.
  • Pumpkin Poke Cake, pumpkin poke cake with a creamy soak.

Make-Ahead Thanksgiving Tips

A few steady habits keep Thanksgiving recipes tasting homemade without last-minute panic:

  • Cook turkey breast the morning of, then rest and carve just before serving.
  • Mash potatoes ahead and rewarm gently with a splash of milk or broth.
  • Bake pumpkin pie the day before so the filling sets cleanly overnight.
  • Toast almonds and chop herbs early so green beans and stuffing finish fast.
  • Warm gravy last so it stays silky when it hits the table.

FAQs

What Thanksgiving recipe should I make first?

For the main dish, start with Oven-Roasted Bone Turkey Breast. For the side everyone reaches for, make Creamy Mashed Potatoes. For dessert, bake Classic Homemade Pumpkin Pie.

Can I make Thanksgiving recipes ahead?

Yes. Classic Homemade Pumpkin Pie, Grandma's Moist Pumpkin Bread, and Rice Stuffing hold well overnight. Mashed potatoes and gravy rewarm gently with a little liquid. Turkey breast is best roasted the day you serve it.

What if I am cooking Thanksgiving dinner for two?

Choose turkey breast instead of a whole bird, then add Creamy Mashed Potatoes, Green Beans with Garlic and Almonds, and Classic Homemade Pumpkin Pie. You still get a full holiday plate without days of prep.

Do you have vegetarian Thanksgiving options?

Yes. Build a plate around Vegan Mashed Potatoes, Vegan Gravy, Rice Stuffing, Green Beans with Garlic and Almonds, and a pumpkin dessert like Classic Homemade Pumpkin Pie or Classic Pumpkin Roll.

What should I serve with turkey besides mashed potatoes?

Add Rice Stuffing, Green Beans with Garlic and Almonds, and Homemade Gravy, then finish with Classic Homemade Pumpkin Pie. That mix covers savory, fresh, and sweet without overcrowding the oven.

Final Thoughts

Good thanksgiving recipes do not need a twelve-dish scramble. Pick one turkey main, two or three sides, gravy, and one pumpkin dessert, and the table feels full. Bookmark this guide, cook what fits your timeline, and let the kitchen smell like herbs, butter, and warm spice until the last plate is cleared.
